speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; can you tell me how long they have been present and if they are itchy or painful? Also, have you noticed any fever or fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chickenpox (Varicella)

Despite up-to-date immunizations, the child's history of close contact with a sibling with chickenpox and exposure to a similarly affected peer at daycare strongly suggests a breakthrough infection. I will confirm this with a physical exam and, if necessary, a viral test.
